solve.work: Average atomic mass = (68.926 amu)(0.6011) + (70.925 amu)(0.3989) = 41.4314 amu + 28.2920 amu = 69.7234 amu ≈ 69.72 amu. The isotopes are both gallium, so they have the same number of protons; the heavier isotope has two more neutrons.

Assume 100 g sample: 89.94 g C and 10.06 g H. Moles C = 89.94 / 12.01 ≈ 7.49 mol; moles H = 10.06 / 1.008 ≈ 9.98 mol. Divide by smaller: C = 1, H ≈ 1.333 = 4/3, so empirical formula is C3H4. Empirical molar mass = 3(12.01)+4(1.008) ≈ 40.06 g/mol. Molecular mass / empirical mass = 120.2 / 40.06 ≈ 3, so molecular formula = C9H12.
